artworks.title: Solicitudo Rustica (Rustic Concerns)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed, expansive landscape from a bird's-eye view. The horizon is high, emphasizing the vastness. In the distance are jagged mountain peaks with some nestled buildings. The etching style features precise linear strokes and hatching, defining the land and mountains. A river with boats winds through the scene, separating land areas with round trees. Near us are buildings, including some larger structures. A figure stands on a path with a staff by their side. The color palette is sepia and black, highlighting the linework.

artworks.title: S. Hieronymus in Deserto (Saint Jerome in the Desert)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The etching depicts a detailed landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon, hills, sky with swirling clouds, water inlets, boats, fortified town, woodlands, rocky outcrops, pathways, tree, and figure engaging in logging activity are all visible. The scene is created using finely hatched lines with varying density for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, indented with stylus, with the verso reddened for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtyard scene with figures in period clothing. The sketch shows several figures in the center, some sitting, others standing with various armaments. To the right, there is an architectural element resembling a balcony with two figures. The drawing captures movement and interaction among the figures, with a focus on the group dynamic and narrative within the scene.

artworks.title: The Crowning with Thorns
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12 × 22.1 cm (4 3/4 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large gathering in a medieval or Renaissance-like setting. The image depicts a crowd gathered in a courtyard, seemingly involved in a public event or demonstration. On the left side of the image, there is a group of figures, some standing on a balcony, others gathered around in the foreground. In the center, a group of figures is clustered around what seems to be a bonfire or some source of light, with flames rising upwards. The figures nearby seem engaged or reacting to the fire, with some seemingly in motion towards it. On the right, more figures stand somewhat detached, while a few are in animated postures. The background architecture suggests a classical or historic stone building, and the lines in the drawing give a sense of shading and depth. The entire scene is rendered in a monochromatic style, using intricate line work and cross-hatching to convey detail and perspective.

artworks.title: The Combat of Avigliana
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed landscape view of a historical battle scene. The background shows distant hills and mountains. A decorative border surrounds a portrait of an individual with military symbols like drums, flags, and shields. The composition features precise linework. The color palette is black and white, emphasizing contrast and detail. Soldiers on horseback and infantrymen are depicted in motion, with distant troops in formations. A coat of arms is featured at the bottom, grounding the image in a historical context.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Il Solimano"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.5 × 13.6 cm (7 11/16 × 5 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing between two pedestals. The person is dressed in elaborate attire with a turban, robe, and holds a staff and a scroll or shield. Around them are classical elements like helmets, stone columns, and a rural background. Above the person is an emblem with circular shapes under a crowned oval and an inscription.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act I
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22 × 28.1 cm (8 11/16 × 11 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural scene with a wide avenue bordered by large buildings featuring classical details and sculptures. In the distance, a triumphal arch is visible at the end of the street. The artwork is an etching with detailed line work and a monochromatic palette of brown tones. Figures in elaborate attire are seen close to the viewer, engaging in what seems to be a procession, while more figures are walking towards the archway in the background.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act II
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.3 × 28.1 cm (8 × 11 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a structured scene from a street perspective. The viewer is at street level, looking down the center of an urban avenue. Two grand buildings flank the scene, leading to a wide archway in the distance where the horizon aligns. The buildings show detailed architectural features like columns, arches, and statues. The illustration uses precise line work to show depth and detail, similar to technical drawings or etchings. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and tan to highlight forms. Figures in ceremonial attire are in a procession near us, moving in a curved formation. Clouds are lightly drawn in the sky above the urban structures.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act III
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22 × 28.3 cm (8 11/16 × 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a wide, open street with ornate buildings on both sides. In the distance, there is a prominent architectural structure resembling a grand gate or pavilion, aligned with the street's vanishing point. The style is characterized by precise, linear engravings and detailed facades. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia and gray tones, emphasizing linework and shadowing. Figures in traditional attire are seen throughout the scene, engaged in various activities. They add movement to the composition against the static architecture, creating depth in the image.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act IV
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to plate mark): 20.2 × 28.2 cm (7 15/16 × 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural perspective view of a city scene. The point of view is from a central position slightly elevated, providing access to both sides of the streets lined with buildings. The horizon is placed towards the upper third of the image, where the street leads to a distant architectural structure. The style of the work appears to be etching with detailed linework suggesting texture and depth in the stone architecture. Close to us, individuals in elaborate attire engage in various activities, suggesting a lively street scene. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on the dark strokes of the engraving and the lighter paper background to emphasize details and create a sense of depth. In the distance, the symmetry of the scene and diminishing detail create a sense of perspective leading the eye towards the vanishing point at the horizon.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act V
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21 × 28.7 cm (8 1/4 × 11 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a city scene with buildings on fire. The image shows fires burning through structures on both sides of a central street. Billowing smoke fills the sky, swirling in intricate patterns. Below, a crowd of figures is engaged in various activities, including running, fighting, and panicking. The architecture is classical, with statues, columns, and decorative facades visible. The scene is dramatic and full of movement and tension.

artworks.title: Alliance of Peace and Abundance
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing close to each other. One figure on the left is standing facing forward with a slight lean to the side, wearing a flowing garment that covers the arms and legs. This figure's hair is styled and adorned with leaves. The facial features are softly carved with a composed expression. The other figure on the right appears to be in motion, with one foot lifted. This figure is garbed in a similarly draped fabric with an exposed leg, and the hair is depicted as swept back. Both figures are holding objects; the one on the left holds a branch, while the one on the right holds a sheaf of wheat. The background is a simple, textured surface.

artworks.title: La Promenade
artworks.medium: 5-color lithograph on china paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 28.1 x 40.8 cm (11 1/16 x 16 1/16 in.)

artworks.title: Pennsylvania Landscape
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river bending into the distance. Trees line the horizon. The drawing is detailed with fine lines, depicting foliage and ripples in the river. It is monochrome with black lines on a light background. In the foreground, there are foliage and grass, while figures or animals can be seen in the water in the distance.

artworks.title: An Iron Forge
artworks.medium: mezzotint
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene at an iron forge. The scene shows a dimly lit space dominated by architectural wooden beams and a stone wall backdrop. A central figure is near glowing embers, and various tools and equipment are scattered in the foreground. The painting conveys a narrative through its composition and use of contrasting light and shadow, showcasing the intense labor and character present in the environment. The style is reminiscent of Joseph Wright of Derby, known for his depictions of industrial and scientific scenes.

artworks.title: Ia Orana Maria (We Greet Thee, Mary)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) in blue
artworks.description: The image shows a person holding a child on their shoulder. The person has long dark hair and wears a long dress. Both individuals are not wearing any jewelry. The background has sketchy lines and abstract shapes.

artworks.title: The Washerwomen (Les laveuses)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) on imitation Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and rounded shapes creating an abstract composition. The thick, curving lines and shaded areas suggest forms. The repetitive, wave-like patterns in the top right resemble layers.

artworks.title: The Madonna with Saint Ulrich and Saint Afra [recto]
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in the image. In the center, a woman is seated on a throne holding a child. The woman has long wavy hair, a crown, and wears a red top and a blue cloak. The child is looking forward. To the left stands a bishop or saint, wearing a green and gold robe and holding a fish. To the right is a figure with a crown of leaves, leaning on a staff. Cherubs surround the figures, with a background of arches and coats of arms.

artworks.title: Title Page for a Missal,  with Satyr and Putti Border [verso]
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page. The artwork features a central block of Latin text in ornate script, framed by intricately designed borders filled with vibrant illustrations of mythical and baroque elements. The top portion of the page contains a depiction of a fantastical creature resembling a dragon or sea serpent intertwined among vines. The left and right borders are richly decorated with figures of cherubs or putti, stylized foliage, and various swirling patterns. The bottom section features a coat of arms or shield with letters and is flanked by winged cherubic figures. The detailed and colorful embellishments serve both as decoration and as a frame to the text, emphasizing its importance and creating a sense of reverence. This is in the style of medieval or Renaissance manuscript illustration.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Brook and Ruins
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape through a narrow frame perspective. A tombstone with the letters "I A" and the year "1545" is on the left. Two large trees flank the scene, and there are scattered architectural fragments. A small arch bridge crosses a body of water in the center. Hills and trees are visible in the distance. The engraving uses precise, linear strokes with cross-hatching and contour lines. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Le stryge (The Vampire)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a high vantage point overlooking a city with a stone gargoyle on the right. In the distance, there is a tower rising above the buildings. The cityscape is filled with rooftops and structures, with birds flying in the sky. The artwork is created with etching techniques, featuring detailed lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of sepia and brown, creating an antique feel. The intricate detailing and use of lines give the image a textured aesthetic.

artworks.title: Barbarossa, Khair-ed-Din
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a drawn portrait of a bearded man. He is in a slightly turned position, facing right. His face is detailed with deep-set eyes, strong eyebrows, prominent nose, and full lips, surrounded by a thick, textured beard and mustache. He wears a large turban covering his head. The man is dressed in a richly patterned garment with buttons along the front. The background is dark and textured. There are no visible jewelry pieces or objects held by the man. The lower portion of the image includes an inscription.

artworks.title: a) The Cabbage Field (Le Champ de choux); b) The Cabbage Field (Le Champ de choux)
artworks.medium:
a) graphite on wove paper; 
b) softground on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a field with cabbages in the foreground, leading towards leafless trees against a boundary wall in the distance. A structure, potentially a house with a chimney, is visible beyond the wall. Quick, sketchy lines convey details in a spontaneous manner. The color palette is limited to neutral tones, and the paper's texture adds a warm, earthy hue. Pencil marks create varying shades of gray for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Cabbage Field (Le Champ de choux)
artworks.medium: softground etching with open-bite tone on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a garden scene with a house in the background. The composition includes lush vegetation in the foreground, a prominent tree on the right, and brushstrokes creating texture throughout. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and gray.
